title: Historical G4 JEV Run - FAILED (Wrong Invented Host)
details: FAILED: Previous run used wrong invented host (https://api.controlnautas.com/v1/jev) and unmapped subdomain api.controlnautas.com which resulted in getaddrinfo failed. Megaplan 12.3 specifies Jev is TypeSafe (endpoint: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model: jev-latest). Old evidence marked FAILED.
